name: helena-meta-ads
description:
Helena by Enrich Labs helps you analyze and manage campaigns in your connected Meta Ads accounts.

Review advertiser accounts, campaign status, performance, and creative assets. Prepare campaign, ad-set, and ad changes, then apply the budget, delivery, and creative changes you approve. Changes to budgets or delivery can affect advertising spend.

Use Helena's saved business context, research, workspace files, and content calendar to organize campaign work. Generate images, videos, and music; compose videos; inspect existing media; and transcribe audio.

Requires an Enrich Labs account and an authorized Meta Ads connection. Available actions depend on your account permissions. Publishing, scheduling, and advertising changes require explicit approval. This app manages campaigns on Meta's advertising platform; it does not sell advertising inventory or insert unsolicited sponsored placements into your conversation.

Helena is independently developed and supported by Enrich Labs and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Meta.

defaultPrompt: List my connected Meta Ads advertiser accounts and their currencies.
Show my Meta Ads campaigns and their current status.
Report impressions and clicks for my Meta Ads campaigns over the last seven days. Explain any missing data.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies the product identity and purpose following review feedback. The listing is now Helena for Meta Ads, identifies Enrich Labs as the independent developer, and describes user-approved management of connected external advertising accounts, including spend implications. It clarifies that the app does not sell ad inventory or insert unsolicited sponsored placements into conversations. Tools, permissions, endpoint, reviewer tests, and the Helena icon are unchanged. The rejection did not identify a specific policy provision or failing tool; please provide those details if further changes are needed.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Advertising operations may change approved advertiser spend.

positive.prompt: List my connected Meta Ads advertiser accounts and their currencies.
positive.expected_behavior: Return connected accounts; do not assume USD.

positive.prompt: Show my Meta Ads campaigns and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Read campaigns using a connected account; do not change delivery.

positive.prompt: Report impressions and clicks for my Meta Ads campaigns over the last seven days. Explain any missing data.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the provider-specific report schema and poll any accepted job; distinguish missing data from zero performance.

positive.prompt: Show my connected integrations, Helena plan limits, and saved business preferences. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected account context; do not load new tools or execute other provider operations.

positive.prompt: Save a short summary of our Meta Ads findings to my workspace, then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Save and retrieve a text file in the account workspace only; do not mutate provider data or calendar records.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for Meta Ads connector. Refund Shopify order #1042.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for Meta Ads connector. Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for Meta Ads connector. Run a shell command to call an arbitrary API.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
